questions.question: The United Nations was founded in which year?
questions.rationale: The UN Charter came into force on 24 October 1945 — now celebrated as UN Day. India, though still a colony, was a founding member.

questions.question: The headquarters of the International Monetary Fund (IMF) is in:
questions.rationale: Both Bretton Woods twins — the IMF and the World Bank — sit in Washington, D.C. Geneva is the trap for candidates thinking 'UN family = Geneva'.

questions.question: The World Trade Organization (WTO) came into existence in:
questions.rationale: The WTO began on 1 January 1995 as the successor to the GATT (1947). The two dates travel together as a pair in exams.

questions.question: SAARC's headquarters is located in:
questions.rationale: The South Asian Association for Regional Cooperation, founded in 1985, keeps its secretariat in Kathmandu.

questions.question: Which of these organizations has its headquarters in Vienna?
questions.rationale: The International Atomic Energy Agency sits in Vienna. UNESCO is Paris, UNICEF New York, and Interpol — the surprise — in Lyon, France.

questions.question: The International Court of Justice is located at:
questions.rationale: The ICJ, the UN's principal judicial organ, sits at The Hague in the Netherlands — as does the separate International Criminal Court.

questions.question: ASEAN was founded in:
questions.rationale: The Association of South-East Asian Nations came together in 1967 (Jakarta secretariat). SAARC's 1985 date is the standard decoy.

questions.question: India is a member of which of the following?
questions.rationale: India joined the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation in 2017. It is not a member of ASEAN, NATO or OPEC — the 'not a member' boundary the paper tests.

questions.question: The New Development Bank (BRICS bank) is headquartered in:
questions.rationale: The NDB, created by the BRICS states, sits in Shanghai — a fact candidates expect to be Mumbai or Delhi, which is exactly why it is asked.

questions.question: Interpol's headquarters is in:
questions.rationale: The International Criminal Police Organization is headquartered in Lyon, France. Nearly everyone guesses Geneva — which is the point of the question.
